purpose: simulation look-ahead NBV teacher distillation into unmodified SmolVLA

policy_abi.task: move the wrist camera to reveal the most useful hidden map area

mapping.volume: one sparse TSDF in ROS map frame
mapping.registration: calibrated TF map<-camera at the source image timestamp
mapping.rule: both sources update the same volume continuously while the base and/or arm move; no image-space blending

frame_admission.tf: map<-camera must exist at the frame timestamp
frame_admission.pose_jump: reject the affected frame only; do not stop mapping

teacher.candidate_source: collision-checked seven-motor targets generated around the selected occluded region
teacher.evaluation: fuse every candidate wrist RGB-D into an independent clone of the same baseline TSDF
teacher.score: new surface voxels + 0.1*new known voxels - 0.02*normalized joint motion
teacher.label: selected candidate seven-motor target
teacher.privileged_data_policy: candidate look-ahead RGB-D and scores are teacher-only and never enter SmolVLA inputs

label_capture_settle.scope: teacher label finalization only; ordinary TSDF fusion continues while moving

accept_only_if: settled final joint target matches label

deployment.authority: proposal only; supervisor validates limits, collision clearance, staleness, and trajectory before application
